stem: How did the events on this time line affect U.S. businesses?

options.label: A
options.text: Profit sharing became a standard practice for industrial corporations.

options.label: B
options.text: Monopolistic practices were abolished by federal legislation.

options.label: C
options.text: Mass-manufacturing techniques were adopted to maximize production.

options.label: D
options.text: Retirement plans were guaranteed to factory workers.

visual_elements: Timeline arrow from 1908 to 1921 with these points: 1908 Ford begins manufacturing the Model T. 1913 Ford introduces the first moving automobile assembly line. 1914 The Ford Motor Company doubles worker pay to $5.00 a day and cuts the length of a shift from nine hours to eight. 1921 The Ford Motor Company accounts for 55 percent of the automotive industry's total production.
